text.text_excerpt: Stopped in at Melt on 12/30 for a late lunch (around 3pm) and it was DELICIOUS! We decided we had to start with an order of the cheese curds, since my friend and I both just spent 6+ months in Wisconsin -- and these were right on par with Wisconsin curds. The marinara and ranch sauces they come with are both excellent. We then ordered the "Owner's Special," which is caramelized onions, gruyere, tomato, and tomato jam on sourdough, and the "Caprese Melt," tomato, basil, mozzarella, and tomato jam on multi-grain. All grilled cheeses come with a side salad, and you can sub out fries or soup for a small charge. They also had a specials board with a few other delicious-looking offerings. Our s...

Melt is a trendy spot in an up and coming area. This description would normally make me run as fast as possible in the opposite direction. But I am here to tell you, it is actually pretty good. I am the first to admit that I didn't choose to come to Melt on my own. It was one of the last days at work for my assistant, and he picked Melt. He even made the waitress take our photo which likely looked ridiculous to every other diner, but I digress. Besides the awkward photo taking, it ended up being a good meal and I'll miss the dude. Enough of that, how about we discuss why you should come here. We started with the cheese curd appetizer. I am normally not a fan of fried cheese, but this vers...

I happened here by mistake. We wanted to eat at Fharmacy, but they were closed. This was a satisfying alternative. The inside kind of reminds me of an indoor picnic. I ordered the chicken parmesan sandwich (chicken parmesan is one of my all-time favorite foods). The chicken was cooked phenomenally. It was crispy and juicy without being overly greasy. My only gripe was the lack of marinara/red gravy/whatever people call it. There was some, but not much. The fries were good too. I'm not crazy for truffle fries, but that is one of the options for a side item. Our waitress was really nice and helpful with suggestions. I also ordered the fried mac and cheese balls, and they are pretty good too.
